text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 26px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; text-anchor: middle

g.text: NON-NEUTRAL clips only; each dataset keeps its own published strength scale.
These models predict emotion labels, not strength. Points need at least 20 clips.
MCAE-SPPS quartiles visualize continuous listener ratings; they are not native intensity classes.
Unknown strength and neutral samples are excluded. Gemma has no eligible completed strength dataset.
